info.cls_ename: Applied Second Foreign Language Elective Courses

description.describe_ch: 針對稍具法文基礎的學生所開設的課程。完成法文(二)課程，學生應學會有關家庭、天氣、季節、表達健康狀況、確認/取消會議、訂餐等基本對話能力。同時可以閱讀基本的法文。
description.describe_eh: This course is for students who have mastered the bare basics of the French language.  At the end of French 2, the student should be able to converse in French regarding one's family, the weather and seasons, express one's health needs, confirm/cancel appointments, and deal with food-related situations such as ordering in a restaurant. Basic written messages should be understood.

targets.describe_en: 1. Able to pronounce correctly when reading or speaking French.

targets.describe_ch: 2.運用基本法文能力練習對話
targets.describe_en: 2. Able to express oneself in basic French in monitored dialogues.
3. Have insight in grammatical differences and able to use grammar correctly and creatively.

targets.describe_ch: 4.瞭解法國與台灣的基本文化差異
targets.describe_en: 4. Be informed about basic cultural differences between France & Taiwan.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom Protocol
	Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
	Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. 
	Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
	Make sure that mobile devices are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent, unless you are instructed to use them for a specific activity.
	Students are not allowed to wear earphones in class.
	If you have problems or questions, contact me as soon as possible by email (available on iLearn)

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
Real-time quizzes are used with students using their smart phones to type/select answers in real time.
Machine tranlation is strongly advised against, unless for individual words and terms. 
Students need to regularly record their own pronunciation, to check progress.
Students are instructed the following:
Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.
